title: rewards.points.accrued v1
description: Emitted after a campaign conversion translates into a confirmed earn. Source publisher: alebrije-mod-rewards-go, EventPublisher.PublishPointsAccrued (internal/service/events_publisher.go:266, event_type stamped at line 267), called from CampaignAccrualConsumer (internal/service/campaign_accrual.go:433). Added 2026-07-03 (DEBT-AUDIT-20260701-019-rewards, option A2). FLAT payload (does NOT use the envelope.v1 data-nested shape) -- fields are top-level, matching the real producer: cmd/server/boot.go:300/429 wire the accrual consumer with the raw Redis-backed EventPublisher (w.publisher), so publish() (events_publisher.go:295) marshals the Event struct directly onto the 'payload' field of both the bare rewards.points.accrued stream and the events:rewards domain mirror. There is no event_version, producer, or data wrapper on this wire shape; occurred_at replaces the envelope's timestamp field. This producer never sets AccountID.

event_id.description: UUID identifying this event (auto-generated by EventPublisher.publish if the caller left it empty).

event_type.description: Stamped by PublishPointsAccrued. Consumers route on this exact value.

user_id.description: Rewards member credited by the campaign conversion.

transaction_id.description: Ledger transaction id of the resulting earn (resp.Transaction.ID). Always set by this producer.

amount.description: Points credited by the campaign conversion (resp.Transaction.Amount).

balance_after.description: Account balance after this accrual (resp.Balance). Always set by this producer.

reason.description: Accrual reason string derived from the campaign conversion.

conversion_id.description: Id of the inbound conversion signal, when present on the triggering event.
